name: Kurosu Kanata
source:
[url=/c7874]Shougo[/url]'s ex-girlfriend who suddenly dropped out and left him without a trace in high school.
Since her disappearance it has been impossible to contact her directly, but she appears in his life once again after a fateful encounter.
She's currently working as a very famous model, though she doesn't like talking about it.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/You_that_became_a_Memory_~Memories_Off~]Wikipedia[/url], translated from [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off%E3%82%B7%E3%83%AA%E3%83%BC%E3%82%BA%E3%81%AE%E7%99%BB%E5%A0%B4%E4%BA%BA%E7%89%A9#.E6.83.B3.E3.81.84.E5.87.BA.E3.81.AB.E3.81.8B.E3.82.8F.E3.82.8B.E5.90.9B_.E3.80.9CMemories_Off.E3.80.9C.E5.88.9D.E5.87.BA]the Japanese Wikipedia[/url] and partly translated from the [url=http://memoriesoff.jp/psp/omokimi/chara.html]Official Site[/url].]
